name: Jumpcoin-Qt
description: Unofficial community-maintained Docker container for the Jumpcoin Qt wallet. Runs the wallet in a headless X server and exposes the GUI through noVNC in any modern browser - no display server or VNC client required. Two branches: standard (clearnet) and Tor (onion routing).

paths.name: Appdata Path
paths.description: Persistent blockchain, wallet, and config. The wallet.dat inside this directory is the only authoritative copy of your coins - back it up regularly.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: noVNC web UI - open http:// :6080/vnc.html in a browser.

ports.name: VNC Port
ports.description: Raw VNC port for TigerVNC / Remmina clients.

ports.name: RPC Port
ports.description: JSON-RPC port. Only expose if you need external RPC access.

variables.name: VNC Password
variables.description: Password for the noVNC web UI and VNC client. If empty, anyone on the network can connect - set this if the port is reachable by others.

variables.name: RPC Password
variables.description: Password for JSON-RPC. Required if you expose the RPC port externally.

variables.name: RPC Allow IP
variables.description: CIDR range allowed to call the JSON-RPC. Default restricts to localhost. Widen only if you need external RPC access.

variables.name: Display Width
variables.description: Horizontal resolution of the virtual desktop in pixels.

variables.name: Display Height
variables.description: Vertical resolution of the virtual desktop in pixels.
